data.user_prompt: Do AI chatbots read FAQ answers that are collapsed on the page?

sections.text:
AI chatbots themselves do not "read" web pages in the way humans do. Instead, they rely on the data they have been trained on or the information provided to them through APIs or web scraping tools. When it comes to FAQ answers that are collapsed on a webpage, whether an AI chatbot can access that content depends on how the data is extracted:

1. If the chatbot is integrated with a system that scrapes the entire webpage's HTML, including the hidden or collapsed sections, then it can access and use that information.
2. If the chatbot only receives visible text or content that is loaded dynamically when a user interacts with the page (e.g., clicks to expand), it might not have access to the collapsed FAQ answers unless the system is designed to expand and capture that content.
3. Some advanced AI systems connected to web browsers or tools can simulate user interactions to reveal hidden content before processing it.

In summary, AI chatbots can access collapsed FAQ answers if the underlying system extracts that content, but they do not inherently "see" or "read" collapsed content on their own.
